metadata.title: The three-dimensional symplectization question for small Seifert L-spaces and further classes
metadata.abstract: We solve the three-dimensional symplectization question for several examples. These include small Seifert fibered $L$-spaces, a family of Whitehead-link surgery $L$-spaces, $S^1\times S^2$, certain surgeries on the figure-eight knot, explicit families of Brieskorn spheres, and arbitrary finite connected sums mixing these manifolds. In particular, the result covers the Weeks manifold and infinitely many hyperbolic $L$-spaces. The main symplectic step is to construct Liouville cobordisms in both directions from a symplectomorphism of symplectizations. The resulting preservation of strong fillability and of the vanishing of the monopole Floer contact invariant, together with the comparison with the Heegaard Floer contact invariant, connected-sum formulas, and classification results for tight contact structures, proves the stated rigidity results.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 若干三流形的辛化刚性
analysis.workSummary: 对小 Seifert L-space、指定 Whitehead 链环手术、Weeks 流形及若干其他族和有限连通和，利用双向 Liouville cobordism 与接触不变量证明辛化问题的刚性结论。
analysis.breakthrough: 将三维辛化辨识推广至包括无穷多个双曲 L-space 的实例族。
analysis.limitations: 结论依赖各族紧接触结构的分类，不能推广为任意三流形的辛化唯一性。
